summary.motive: Use the stretch-action pocket reset to attack the middle of Cover 3 Sky with a Dagger — seam above, curl in the void behind the dropping MLB.
summary.whyItWorks: MIKE must turn and run with the seam or the tight end wins over the top instantly; the moment he commits his eyes there, Z's curl sits undefended in the exact grass he just vacated.
summary.failureMode: A MOFO-spinning safety or a MIKE who plays the curl first with trail technique on the seam forces the QB into his checkdown, turning the shot into a three-yard gain.

beats.title: Identical Run Picture
beats.text: The offensive line reaches and the mesh is real — the tight end even lands his drive step on the edge setter, so no defender can separate this frame from the base stretch.

beats.title: The Seam Releases Behind the Edge
beats.text: Y slips off a block the SDE fully bought and climbs the seam between the linebackers; MIKE bails into his hook-curl drop with his eyes glued to the climbing tight end.

beats.title: Z Settles Into the Void
beats.text: With MIKE turned chasing the seam and RCB trailing the stem, Z plants at nine yards directly behind the linebacker's shoulders — the textbook dagger void.

beats.title: Shot Over the Linebacker
beats.text: From the back of the pocket the QB throws the curl over MIKE's outside shoulder; the free safety is 12 yards deep splitting verticals and has no play on an intermediate ball.

relations.tell: The QB never leaves the pocket — the ride ends in a hitch-and-reset rather than a handoff, a boot pivot, or a carried-out fake.
